what: Overlay that adds a bilingual Chinese/English interface with a language switch to the dsh-whale-widget DSH plugin.
verifiedHow: Full gate suite green in the source fork (probe --strict, differential stub-DOM smoke test with 94/94 Chinese DOM writes identical to upstream, host apply+route smoke test, panel audit with 0 untranslated strings in any panel), plus a live check in the DSH desktop app: /dsh-whale/lang.json went 404 -> 401 and ~/.dsh/.dshw-lang.json appeared with lang=en.
notes: The overlay files were built against upstream 0.3.18; the installer refuses to overwrite a plugin whose base files do not match baseAssetsSha256/baseLibSha256 unless --force/-Force is given.
Both dictionaries are inlined, so installing needs no build step and no network access when the plugin is already installed.
User data (bubble content, custom roles and audio, .dshw-lang.json) lives in DSH_HOME and is never touched.
dsh plugin refuses the desktop profile by design; for that profile the overlay is copied in place, which is why a re-apply script exists.
